Generate shell completions

```
inference completions [OPTIONS] <SHELL>
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `<SHELL>` | required | Shell to generate completions for. Possible values: `bash`, `elvish`, `fish`, `powershell`, `zsh`. |
